basic_details.job_title: GBPUAT Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: One Project Assistant fellowship is open in the Department of Soil Science of G. B. Pant University of Agriculture & Technology, Pantnagar, under the project "To assess the efficacy of KRISHAJ 60 (NPK 13.2-13.2-13.2 liquid fertilizer enriched with MgO, Cu (EDTA), Fe (EDTA),Mn, (EDTA) Zn, (EDTA) B and Mo) Products on yield of Paddy" (Project Code 2611). The emolument is Rs 22,000/- on a six monthly basis, and candidates with an Undergraduate in Agriculture/ Science (ZBC) are eligible. The application form printed in the notice must be sent to the Principal Investigator and received by 5 Decembe

how_to_apply: The application form is printed on the notice itself. The notice asks candidates to fill it in, attach copies of their documents and send it to the Principal Investigator at his/her departmental address: Dr. Ajeet Pratap Singh, Principal Investigator, Department of Soil Science, G. B. Pant University of Agriculture & Technology, Pantnagar-263145. The application must be received by 5 December 2026.

Fill in the form: name of the fellowship (Project Assistant), name of the project, name of applicant, father's name, date of birth, address with mobile number and email ID, category, experience (if any) and research papers published.
Complete the Education Qualification table: exam passed, name of the board/university, year of passing, % of marks (OGPA), division, subject and remarks.
Affix a photograph in the box on the form.
Sign the form as the applicant.
Enclose attested copies of all certificates, degree and testimonials.
Send the application to the Principal Investigator at the departmental address above so that it is received by 5 December 2026.
Application form with photograph affixed and signed.
Attested copies of all certificates, degree and testimonials (must be enclosed).
Original certificates, to be produced at the time of interview.
important_instructions: No interim correspondence will be entertained. Copies of the notice have been sent to the notice board of the concerned college and department and to the Officer In-charge of the university website.

content_sections.heading: About GBPUAT Project Assistant
content_sections.text: G. B. Pant University of Agriculture & Technology is an agricultural university at Pantnagar-263145. The Project Assistant will work in its Department of Soil Science on a project that assesses the efficacy of KRISHAJ 60, an NPK 13.2-13.2-13.2 liquid fertilizer enriched with MgO and micronutrients, on the yield of paddy. The Principal Investigator of the project is Dr. Ajeet Pratap Singh.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates having an Undergraduate in Agriculture/ Science (ZBC) are eligible for the Project Assistant fellowship. The "Experience required" row of the notice is marked "-", and the category of the fellowship is printed as "Not applicable". The application form asks for any experience and any research papers published, so candidates can list these if they have them. The notice does not mention an age limit. For the exact eligibility wording, candidates can check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Emolument of fellowship: Rs 22,000/-. Duration of fellowship: six monthly basis. The engagement will be given for six month, which may be extended as per requirement.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GBPUAT Project Assistant
content_sections.text: The application form is printed on the notice itself. The notice asks candidates to fill it in, attach copies of their documents and send it to the Principal Investigator at his/her departmental address: Dr. Ajeet Pratap Singh, Principal Investigator, Department of Soil Science, G. B. Pant University of Agriculture & Technology, Pantnagar-263145. The application must be received by 5 December 2026. Fill in the form: name of the fellowship (Project Assistant), name of the project, name of applicant, father's name, date of birth, address with mobile number and email ID, category, experience (if any) and research papers published. Complete the Education Qualification table: exam passed, name of the board/university, year of passing, % of marks (OGPA), division, subject and remarks. Affix a photograph in the box on the form. Sign the form as the applicant. Enclose attested copies of all certificates, degree and testimonials. Send the application to the Principal Investigator at the departmental address above so that it is received by 5 December 2026. Application form with photograph affixed and signed. Attested copies of all certificates, degree and testimonials (must be enclosed). Original certificates, to be produced at the time of interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The interview for the GBPUAT Project Assistant fellowship will be held on 7 December 2026 at 11:00 a.m. in the Department of Soil Science . No separate interview letter will be issued for this purpose, and no TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. Candidates must produce their original certificates at the time of interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No interim correspondence will be entertained. Copies of the notice have been sent to the notice board of the concerned college and department and to the Officer In-charge of the university website.
